heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service category.

items.question: Which eCommerce platform is best for my business?
items.answer: It depends on catalog size, budget, customization needs and growth plans. We review your requirements and recommend WooCommerce, Shopify, Magento or a custom build, with the trade-offs explained.

items.question: Can you integrate local payment gateways and couriers?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate card gateways, mobile wallets, bank transfer, cash on delivery and the leading courier services used in Pakistan and abroad.

items.question: How long does it take to build an online store?
items.answer: A standard store usually takes 4 to 8 weeks, while custom stores and marketplaces take 3 to 6 months depending on features and integrations.

items.question: Will my store be SEO friendly and fast?
items.answer: Yes. Every store is responsive, optimized for speed and built with search-friendly structure and on-page SEO basics.

items.question: Do you offer maintenance after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide security updates, backups, performance tuning, hosting support and new feature development.
